style.backgroundSystem: warm rice-paper parchment #F4EDDE for packshot and detail screens, deep pine-green botanical panel #34523F for benefit and trust screens, dark ink-brown ground #262119 for macro and closing screens; no landscape photography, no paper grain
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single amber #B07A3C accent
style.lightingSystem: soft warm studio key from the front left with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, 4800K-5200K warm grade; skimming light only on macro screens to trace root texture
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm botanical tonic-food visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm rice-paper #F4EDDE, deep pine green #34523F, dark ink brown #262119 and one amber accent #B07A3C; soft warm studio lighting with a front-left key and gentle contact shadows, 4800K-5200K warm grade; pale natural oak wood as the recurring surface; one humanist sans-serif family; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and product scale; whole root always shown with its fine rootlets unclipped
style.surfaceSystem: pale natural oak wood board #BE9B6B as the recurring table surface, with one unbleached linen cloth #E3D9C4 for the scene screen
style.typography: humanist sans-serif, one family across the set, no calligraphy
